vibe_rationale: Quirky suitcase-only vintage and makers market with a loyal community, but small, casual and stall-only with thin programming.
fit_notes: Thrifty, style-conscious adult shoppers with weak wellness adjacency, so a generic retail crowd. The market runs on the 1st and 3rd Sundays in the CBD, so low-cost repeat sampling has limited reach, though the organiser also runs Rummages in Sydney and Melbourne.
